# `brass_compass.destinations` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The pure part: a compass's entries and the choice per dimension, with no Minecraft imports (docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md).

### `record Destinations(int version, List<Entry> entries, Map<String, Integer> current)` — `src/main/java/brass_compass/destinations/Destinations.java`
Everything a brass compass remembers (docs/spec/contracts/data-contract.md): entries in the order they were saved, the chosen entry per dimension, and the schema version.
- `int VERSION` — The schema this build writes.
- `Destinations EMPTY`
- `boolean readOnly()` — True when written by a newer build than this one: shown, never edited.
- `Saved save(String dimension, int x, int y, int z, String name)` — Saves a lodestone: an entry already at that place is returned as it is (COMPASS-REQ-010), otherwise a new one is appended.
- `Destinations rename(int index, String name)`
- `Destinations remove(int index)` — Removes an entry; indices above it shift down and the per-dimension choices follow (or vanish).
- `Destinations choose(String dimension, int index)` — Chooses an entry for its own dimension (COMPASS-REQ-015); an index in another dimension is refused.
- `Destinations markPresent(int index, boolean present)`
- `OptionalInt chosenIndex(String dimension)` — The chosen entry's index in a dimension, if any.
- `Optional<Entry> chosen(String dimension)`
- `OptionalInt indexOf(String dimension, int x, int y, int z)`
- `List<Integer> indicesIn(String dimension)` — The indices of the entries in one dimension, in saved order (UI-REQ-002).

    - **nested** `record Saved(Destinations destinations, int index, boolean created)`
    The result of saving: the destinations and the index of the entry, new or already there.

### `record Entry(String dimension, int x, int y, int z, String name, boolean present)` — `src/main/java/brass_compass/destinations/Entry.java`
One saved lodestone: where it is, what the holder called it, and whether it was there the last time the compass looked (docs/spec/domains/compass.md, entry lifecycle).
- `boolean samePlace(String otherDimension, int ox, int oy, int oz)` — The same lodestone?
- `Entry withName(String newName)`
- `Entry withPresent(boolean isPresent)`

### `class Names` — `src/main/java/brass_compass/destinations/Names.java`
Entry names as the spec bounds them: plain text, at most 32 characters, a default from the position (COMPASS-FAIL-002, UI-FAIL-002).
- `int MAX_LENGTH`
- `char FORMATTING` — Minecraft's formatting prefix, the section sign.
- `String sanitize(String raw, String fallback)` — Strips formatting codes and control characters, trims, truncates; an empty result becomes the fallback.
- `String defaultFor(int x, int y, int z)`
